sentences.text:
Smt. Neha vs Smt. Gomti on 4 February, 2026
 Neutral Citation No. 2026:Mphc-Jbp:10026
 1 
 In The High Court Of Madhya Pradesh

Before
 Hon'Ble Shri Justice Deepak Khot

On The 4 th Of February, 2026
 Misc. Civil Case No. 163 of 2025
 Smt. Neha
 Versus
 Smt. Gomti And Others
 Appearance:
 Shri Sandeep Koshta - Advocate for the applicant.
 Shri Amrit Kaur Ruprah - Advocate for the respondent 
 Order
The respondents though served but remain unrepresented.
Therefore, the matter is heard finally at the motion stage.
The present application has been filed by the applicant who is the widow of the deceased for transfer of claim case which has been filed by the mother and siblings of the deceased at Bhopal to Sagar.

It is the case of the applicant that she has filed the application for grant of compensation on account of death of the husband of the applicant in an accident under the provisions of Motor Vehicles Act before Motor Accidents Claims Tribunal, Sagar.
It is further submitted that the mother and other siblings of the deceased have also filed an application for grant of compensation before the Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Bhopal.

It is further submitted that if both the applications continue before different claims tribunal then there is a probability of conflict of interest and NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2026:MPHC-JBP:10026 2 MCC-163-2025 contrary findings.
It is also submitted that the applicant being the widow has no means to travel to Bhopal to participate in the proceedings of the application.
For the reasons mentioned in the application which is supported by an affidavit and also for the reasons mentioned hereinabove, the present MCC is allowed.
Accordingly, the Claim Case No.734/20232 pending before the 7 th MACT,
Bhopal is directed to be transferred to 2 n d MACT, Khurai Sagar where the claim application filed by the applicant is pending.
The MACT, Khurai Sagar is directed to consolidate the proceedings of both the claims application and decide it by a common order to avoid conflict of interest and contrary finding.
